The following events took place in '''4980 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]''':

==Events==
*The [[Exile fleet|remnants]] of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], having [[Sith exodus|wandered]] for [[4999 BBY|almost twenty years]], arrive on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. There, the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] founds a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|new Sith Empire]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
